Hi all, I'm Calder and I'm a representation theorist currently at Yale. As I learn the basics of Lean, I am interested in doing so with a view toward contributing to mathlib in areas related to representation theory and Lie theory.
Would a reasonable place to start here be to fill in the details of Maschke's theorem, sketched in the link as "future work"?
With more experience, I'd be very excited to see if it is feasible to tackle some basics of Category O. If this has been previously discussed or worked on (or if anyone has any other thoughts or advice n general to share about this) I'd be very curious to know.
Thanks, and nice to meet you all!
I definitely think we're ready for Category O although I suspect that the first step is to set up the representation theory of Lie algebras which I don't think we have yet?

Hi @Calder Morton-Ferguson , and welcome! I'd be very interested in the development of Maschke's theorem and of that file that needs some love. If you open a PR feel free to ping me for a review. I hope you'll have fun digging into this formalizing world.
